description: This script manages the review lifecycle for HAL component metadata, facilitating starting, stopping, and clearing review cycles by modifying metadata.yaml files and generating reports.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Finds and lists all components by locating metadata.yaml files and extracting their directory paths.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays help information about how to use the script.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Resolves and verifies the path to a component's metadata.yaml file.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Calculates a date after adding a specified number of business days, skipping weekends.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Clears lifecycle dates in the metadata.yaml file.

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Regenerates the RAG status report after modifying metadata.
